headline: Apartments in Azerbaijan Up 8.4% in One Year – Rental Rates Have Also Risen
summary: Azerbaijan's housing price index rose 8.4% in the third quarter of 2026 compared with a year earlier, and rental rates have also risen, according to Trend.Az.
why: Housing price trends indicate property-market strength and inflation pressure, which matter for investors in Azerbaijani real estate and banks with mortgage exposure.
